t: Pike vs the Automaton: Pike vs the Automaton Album Review | Pitchfork
s: February 17, 2022 - Pike vs the Automaton feels instinctive and easygoing, like the guitarist fired up his amp while he was having his morning coffee, and these were the songs that spilled out. Some of those songs, naturally, sound a lot like his other bands. “Abusive” opens the album right in Pike’s sweet spot, with a stomping, Sabbath-on-speed riff and roaring vocals that give way to a frantic yet tuneful guitar solo.

s: February 14, 2022 - It moves away from being bludgeoning metal to having, at times, a more stoner vibe, such as on the crushingly heavy ‘Trapped in a Midcave’ and the dense ‘Alien Slut Mum’.
